svg.title: Diagnose Before You Fix
svg.desc: A yes/no diagnosis path: check that the context is present, that facts come from one current source, that the instruction is specific and not contradicted, and that the chat is still short, fixing the first 'no' found; only then raise effort or step up the model, changing one thing and retesting with the same input.
svg.text: Answer in order; fix the first 'no', then retest.
Replace the stale or duplicate file
